results.title: Uktena Returns
results.overview: The origin story of the Native American myth of Uktena, the Horned Serpent. UKTENA had been contained in the cave but mankind's greed and destruction of Mother Earth, allowed the beast to escape the confines of the cave and begin to go on a rampage once again. A major conflict with the local armed forces erupts and UKTENA is unstoppable. A Native American woman, the descendent of the shaman that cast the original spell, uses a sacred totem to reverse the spell and turn UKTENA back into the human he once was.

results.title: Our Son
results.overview: Two childless married couples raise an unexpected son from an illicit affair between the two households. Amidst the chaos that follows a paternity reveal, the two wives take parenting into their own hands.

results.title: Shadow Wounds
results.overview: After waking alone in a dark forest with no memory of how she got there, a young woman follows a mysterious lantern while being haunted by whispers that seem to know her deepest fears. As reality and nightmare begin to merge, she must confront the truth hidden within the shadows before it consumes her completely.

results.title: By His Hand
results.overview: Emma has spent her entire life trapped in Fowler’s fundamentalist cult. After a final act of humiliation, she decides to flee. Sam, a fellow member, bound by guilt and defiance, agrees to help her escape.

results.title: Gobbledygook
results.overview: A girl encounters an other worldly entity through her television set with every click of the remote.

results.title: The Day I Smoked a Cigarette with My Father
results.original_title: Le jour où j'ai fumé une cigarette avec mon père
results.overview: Cairo, 1964. Alaa, a 12-year-old boy, and his three younger siblings hear shouting from the street. Outside, the crowd is cheering for a man. The children can barely believe their eyes: the man is their father, Ibrahim.

results.title: I Think About Killing You
results.overview: Team captain Dani is plagued by invasive fantasies of killing her abusive coach. When the coach pushes the team too far, Dani must choose whether or not to act on her fantasies of violence.

results.title: Our Secret
results.overview: A Black Brazilian family in the city of Belo Horizonte, tries to rebuild their home after a recent loss. Caught between memories and nightmares, and unable to express what they feel to each other, a mother and her children shield themselves from the pain of grief through their individual routines. Only the youngest child understands the secret that the house holds within its four walls and tries to reveal it to the others, only to fall on deaf ears. Finally, confronted with the truth, they face the deep roots of their grief and come together to traverse this moment with love and courage.

results.title: Sirens Call
results.overview: In their feature-length debut, Gossing/Sieckmann dive into the merfolk subculture with performance artist and siren Una. Genre elements, fiction and documentary, self-care, political activism and self-chosen identities blend into one another.

results.title: No. 1 Sentai Gozyuger VS Boonboomger
results.original_title: ナンバーワン戦隊ゴジュウジャーVSブンブンジャー
results.overview: The Boonboomgers' run in the Big Bang Grand Prix is violently interrupted when the universe's top-ranked monster, Universe No. 1, appears and triggers a catastrophic universe fusion, causing parallel worlds to merge into one chaotic continuum. While Taiya Hando/Bun Red is suddenly transported to Planet Shaft, he's attacked by the Bitter Demon Beast Galaxy Circuit Guruma until Hoeru Tono/Gozyu Wolf arrives to back him up. Meanwhile on Earth, the remaining Gozyugers battle Universe No. 1. Bun Blue, Bun Pink, and Bun Black return to help, but the monster overwhelms them and defeats the combined teams. Hoeru then reappears in a dramatic new evolution: Saint Gozyu Wolf, declaring his vow to "stop the battle." With a slash that cuts through space itself, he sends all eight heroes hurtling into another dimension, setting the stage for the film's multiversal conflict.

results.title: Eleven Days
results.overview: In the sweltering heat of a Texas summer in 1974, Jim Estelle, head of the Texas Department of Corrections, plays a deadly game against the ruthless Federico Carrasco, a convicted heroin dealer who has taken over the Huntsville Penitentiary and holding dozens hostage after his pre-planned escape has gone awry. Lines between captor and captive, justice and survival, begin to blur as the siege spirals for eleven endless, terrifying days.

results.title: Lavender
results.overview: When lesbian writer Audrey runs into her ex-boyfriend, Julian, she must confront her bisexual panic or risk losing her sense of identity.

results.title: Pleasure-Seeking
results.overview: Suffering a pervasive sense of loneliness, Sasha spends her days chasing a constant stream of dopamine—until a bizarre physical malady and a persistent neighbour unearth her unravelling mental state.

results.title: Stardom in Fuji 2026 Feb.
results.overview: Stardom in Fuji 2026 Feb. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on February 15, 2026, at Fujisan Messe in Fuji, Shizuoka, Japan.

results.title: Sternbrücke Forever
results.overview: A declaration of love to an edifice and its people, and a tirade against urban politics. Mehmet sells falafel, Martina has a kiosk and Stefan repairs cars. And every weekend, young people fill the clubs under the Sternbrücke – one of more than a hundred old railway bridges in Hamburg. But its time is up: the plan is to take down the bridge and replace it.

results.title: Happily Ever After
results.overview: As one sister prepares for marriage and the other resists every convention it represents, their fragile bond is tested by love, family expectations, and the question of whether happiness can ever truly be chosen.

results.title: Once You Shall Be One of Those Who Lived Long Ago
results.original_title: En gång skall du vara en av dem som levat för längesen
results.overview: A documentary about the remaining people in Malmberget in north Sweden, a small town collapsing into the mines beneath it. As residents reflect on the once vibrant community, the town itself is slowly dismantled around them

results.title: Glasshouse
results.overview: A surreal psychological drama that follows Stretch, a troubled high school student teetering on the edge of emotional collapse, as he navigates a distorted and often hostile reality.
